theme_and_archetype.vibe: Night-mode DoorDash. Trustworthy, hyper-efficient, tactile, and eye-catching.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: The user requested an UberEats/DoorDash inspired app using an Amber Yellow and Black color scheme. This demands a dark theme with deep obsidian black to reduce glare for gig workers, paired with a high-visibility, energetic Amber accent for conversion and active states. It prioritizes function, speed, and clear typography.

primary.description: Amber Yellow. Use strictly for primary CTAs (Accept Job, Pay), active map pins, and glowing progress indicators.

background.description: Deep obsidian black to save OLED battery and provide maximum contrast. Never use pure #000000, always tint slightly.

typography.rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. Use tight tracking for headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Tactile elements. Mobile-first hierarchy.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Containers with borders MUST use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass. bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#262626].
surface_strategies.cards: Solid flat bg-[#141414], rounded-2xl, border border-[#262626]. NO soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders.
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-2 border-[#262626] rounded-xl focus:border-[#FFBF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FFBF00].
surface_strategies.premium_card: The 'Professional ($300)' package card should have a glowing 'Tracing Beam' effect or a solid 2px border of #FFBF00 with a subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,191,0,0.15)].

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl (rounded-xl preferred for structural look). Primary button is pure #FFBF00 with #0A0A0A text. Font-bold. Active state scales down slightly (scale-95).
component_rules.map: Leaflet integration. CRITICAL: Standard OpenStreetMap tiles are bright white/green and will ruin the dark mode. Apply CSS filter on the Leaflet tile layer if a dark tileset isn't available: 'filter: invert(100%) hue-rotate(180deg) brightness(95%) contrast(90%);'. Use a custom SVG icon for pins (Amber Yellow #FFBF00).
component_rules.security_code_input: Use a 6-digit OTP UI layout. 6 individual square boxes (w-14 h-14), text-center, text-2xl font-mono. border-[#262626] focus:border-[#FFBF00].
component_rules.step_by_step_camera: Use Shadcn Tabs or a vertical Stepper component to guide the inspector (Front, Back, Interior, Engine, VIN).
component_rules.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 2 or 2.5 for a bold, legible look.

hero_background.description: Yellow sports car at night. Use as landing page hero background. CRITICAL: Add overlay bg-black/70 so white/amber text is clearly readable.

inspector_action.description: Young man checking car engine. Use in the 'Become an Inspector' or 'How it works' section.

map_placeholder.description: Areal view of city lights at night. Can be used as a placeholder background behind the map container before map loads.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons brighten (hover:brightness-110). Cards get a border highlight.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (framer-motion initial={{opacity:0, y:10}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}}).
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Map pins should pulse gently to indicate live jobs.

landing_page.layout: Massive Hero Section with the 'Yellow sports car' bg. High-contrast typography. Bento grid below showing dual value props: 'Inspect a Car Anywhere' (Buyer) and 'Earn by Inspecting' (Inspector).
landing_page.ctas: Two main CTAs: 'Request Inspection' (Primary #FFBF00) and 'Become an Inspector' (Outline/Ghost white).

buyer_dashboard.layout: Control Room grid. Top widget: Active requests and live status timeline. Main area: Form to create new request (Vehicle Info -> Location -> Package Selection -> Tip).
buyer_dashboard.pricing_cards: Display Basic ($100), Premium ($250), Professional ($300) in a 3-column bento. Professional card MUST be highlighted with Amber border.
buyer_dashboard.testing: All form inputs and submit buttons MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buyer-car-make-input').

inspector_dashboard.layout: Split view / Hybrid App style. Top 50vh is the Leaflet Map showing nearby jobs. Bottom 50vh is a scrollable list of job cards (Job title, distance, payout).
inspector_dashboard.job_flow: Clicking a job opens a Modal/Drawer. Clicking 'Accept' transitions to the Inspection UI. Inspection UI requires 6-digit Security Code input to start.
inspector_dashboard.inspection_ui: Focused, distraction-free view. Step-by-step instructions. Big camera placeholder buttons.
inspector_dashboard.testing: Map markers, Accept buttons, and the 6-digit code inputs MUST have data-testid attributes.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, map-pins). Format: kebab-case, role-based.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds MUST meet APCA guidelines. Use Text-shadow on hero texts if needed.
